_comment: Grid-scored core with per-surface stochastic resin halo (notes/novel.md, notes/refs/laustsen2014_grid_scored_rve.md). Saw-cut walls+root: opened cells, full halo from core.cell_size. Unsawn faces: thinner closed-cell halo (face.scale x saw_cut reach). P(resin)=max over active surfaces; local stiffness is P*C_resin+(1-P)*C_foam at Gauss points. Requires numpy backend.
